# Revelation Media Resources

> Free evangelistic series kit for pastors: prophecy seminar presentations, images, videos and promo materials, editable in PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides.

Revelation Media Resources is a free library of ready-made materials for running an evangelistic prophecy series: presentations, slides, images, videos, and promotional materials for pastors, churches, and ministry organizations.

## Key facts

- Audience: Pastors, church leaders and ministry organizations
- Price: free
- Formats: PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides
- What is included: 9 presentations, ~450 slides, ~400 images, 10 videos, 20 marketing assets
- Program stages: Promote and invite; Lead the meetings; Enrich with media; Hand out; Celebrate
- Site languages: English (https://kazizova-omb.github.io/evangelism-library-landing/), Español (https://kazizova-omb.github.io/evangelism-library-landing/es)

## How to get the kit

Every resource is free to download. No registration and no sign-in: the original resources are released under CC0 1.0. Downloads: https://kazizova-omb.github.io/evangelism-library-landing/#get
- Presentations: PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides
- Images: Original artwork for slides and print
- Videos: Clips for the key moments of the series
- Promotional materials: Posters, social posts, invitations
- Handouts and certificates: Study sheets, handouts, certificates
Updates: Sign up to hear about new resources, translations, and announcements. (One Voice 27 newsletter, optional)

## FAQ

### What is Revelation Media Resources?

Revelation Media Resources is a free library of ready-made materials for running an evangelistic prophecy series: presentations, slides, images, videos, and promotional materials for pastors, churches, and ministry organizations.

### Is it really free?

Yes. The full kit is free for pastors, churches, and ministry organizations: everything downloads directly, with no registration. The original resources are released under CC0 1.0, a public domain dedication, so you may freely use, adapt, translate, and share them for your ministry, without asking permission or giving credit.

### Who can use these materials?

Pastors, church leaders, and ministry organizations who want to run an evangelistic series. No design skills are needed: the files are ready to present and easy to adapt to your church.

### What formats are included?

Presentations come in PowerPoint, Keynote, and Google Slides. Images and videos are provided in standard formats that work on any device.

### Can I edit the materials?

Yes. You can change text, reorder slides, and add your church's details to fit your program.

### Which languages are available?

The kit is available in English today. More languages are coming soon and will be added progressively; see the list in the translation section below. Fluent in another language? You can help us translate it.
